create.title: New table
create.namePh: e.g. Progress log / Cost breakdown / Checklist

column.deleteConfirm: All cell data in this column will be removed.
column.aggregateHint: Auto-compute sum/avg/min/max of this column's values at the bottom row of the table.

cell.selectEmptyPh: No options — add in column settings

empty.title: No tables yet
empty.body: Store structured data (accounts · assets · contacts …) per workspace.
empty.firstColumn: Add a column to get started
empty.firstColumnHint: e.g. Company, Owner, Status, Due date

attach.title: Add attachment
attach.uploadHint: Click or drop a file here
attach.newHint: A new document is created, linked to this cell automatically, and its editor opens in a new window.

survey.title: Collect as survey
survey.lead: Anyone with the link can respond without signing in. Each response becomes a row in this table, and only people who can see this document can see responses.
survey.saveFailed: Couldn't save. Please try again shortly.
survey.blocked: Documents whose security level isn't «General» can't collect responses from outside.
survey.questionsHint: Adding or editing columns changes the questions. «Hidden» columns don't appear on the form (internal use, like owner or status). Secret columns are always excluded.
survey.noColumns: Add a column to the table first.
survey.closeConfirmMsg: The current link will stop accepting responses. Reopening creates a new link. Responses already received stay in the table.

public.notFoundHint: The link may have changed or the survey may be closed. Please check with the sender.
public.closedHint: It has closed or reached its response limit.
public.done: Your response has been sent. Thank you.
public.tooMany: Please try again in a moment.
public.errGeneric: Couldn't send. Please check your answers.
public.errNetwork: Connection is unstable. Please try again.

err.invalid_option: Please choose one of the options.
err.invalid_datetime: Please check the date and time.
err.invalid_url: Please check the link (starts with https://).
err.empty_response: Please answer at least one question.
err.already_responded: This link has already been used to answer.
err.too_many: Please try again in a moment.
err.network: Connection is unstable. Please try again.
err.generic: Couldn't send. Please check your answers.

survey.noQuestions: No questions yet. Start with «Add question» below.
survey.otherColumns: {{n}} column(s) not shown to respondents (attachments, URL, checkbox…) appear only in the Responses table.
survey.anonymousHint: Answers aren't linked to who sent them. Pointless when a round has one recipient. Applies to responses received after you turn it on.
survey.thanksPh: e.g. Thanks for your feedback — we'll use it to serve you better.
survey.deleteQuestionMsg: Answers to this question will also be removed from the {{n}} responses already received.
survey.convertBanner: This table is collecting survey responses.

stats.empty: No responses yet. Once they arrive, they'll be summarized by column.
stats.multiHint: Multiple picks allowed — totals can exceed 100%
